entities.name: Ramón Carrizales
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ramón Alonso Carrizales Rengifo is a Venezuelan politician who was the vice president of Venezuela from January 2008 to January 2010. Carrizales was a Colonel of the Venezuelan Armed Forces and was educated at the Venezuelan Academy of Military Sciences, where he graduated in 1974.

entities.name: Ramón Carrizales
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ramón Alonso Carrizales Rengifo is a Venezuelan politician who was the vice president of Venezuela from January 2008 to January 2010. Carrizales was a Colonel of the Venezuelan Armed Forces and was educated at the Venezuelan Academy of Military Sciences, where he graduated in 1974.
